allOf.description: Names the Egeria information supply chains that a run is part of.  Egeria tags the lineage it catalogues from the run with these information supply chains, creating each lineage relationship once for each of them.

iscQualifiedName.description: Qualified name of the information supply chain that the run is part of.

iscQualifiedNames.description: Qualified names of the information supply chains that the run is part of, when it is part of several.
